dialogue.content: こんばんは。本日はよろしくお願いいたいます
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for being here today.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。こちらこそ、本日はよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Likewise, thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: 準備がよろしければ、予定よりだいぶ早いですがはじめさせてもらってもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: If you're ready, would it be alright if we start quite a bit earlier than scheduled?

dialogue.content: お差し支えなければ、私は、いつ開始されても大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: If it's no trouble for you, I'm ready to start whenever.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。それでは、はじめますね。
dialogue.English: Thank you. Then, let's begin.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 相談員です。本日はご相談いただきありがとうございます
dialogue.English: I'm the counselor. Thank you for reaching out today.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします…
dialogue.English: Thank you...

dialogue.content: 本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 初めて利用しますが、同居している義父の件でご相談したくて…
dialogue.English: This is my first time using this service, and I'd like to talk about my live-in father-in-law...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・・いろいろとお困りなんですね
dialogue.English: I see... It sounds like you're dealing with a lot.

dialogue.content: 義父さまのどんなことでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What about your father-in-law is troubling you?

dialogue.content: はい、困ってます
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm having a hard time.

dialogue.content: とても元気に外出する義父が心配です
dialogue.English: I'm worried about my father-in-law; he's very energetic and goes out a lot.

dialogue.content: コロナ感染が地域で増えてます
dialogue.English: COVID infections are increasing in our area.

dialogue.content: 近くで感染者が増えているとなるととても心配になりますね
dialogue.English: It must be very worrying to have the number of cases increasing nearby.

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes,

dialogue.content: 小学生の子が二人いますが
dialogue.English: We have two elementary school children,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 今朝、学校から連絡がきて、児童の感染者が出て休校になりました
dialogue.English: This morning, we got a call from the school. They're closing because a student tested positive.

dialogue.content: おじいちゃんの交友関係は広くて
dialogue.English: Grandpa has a wide circle of friends and is very social,

dialogue.content: それは大変ですね。身近でそのようなことがあると焦りますね
dialogue.English: That sounds difficult. It's natural to feel anxious when something like that happens so close to home.

dialogue.content: はい。焦りました。
dialogue.English: Yes. I panicked.

dialogue.content: かぶってしまいすいません。つづけてくださいね
dialogue.English: I'm sorry for interrupting. Please, continue.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 正直、私はあまり実感がないタイプでしたが、
dialogue.English: To be honest, I was the type of person who didn't feel it was a real threat, but...

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: ご近所では、感染者の方への差別的な言動や態度は見受けられました…他県の車をひどく嫌がっていて
dialogue.English: I've seen discriminatory words and attitudes toward infected people in the neighborhood... like being very hostile to cars with out-of-prefecture license plates.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: おじいちゃんは、電車を利用して元気に外出するので、ご近所の方も心配？してくれましたが
dialogue.English: Since Grandpa takes the train and goes out energetically, our neighbors have also 'expressed concern,' but...

dialogue.content: いろいろと風向きが変わりそうな予感がします
dialogue.English: I have a feeling the tide may be turning in various ways.

dialogue.content: おじいさまはとても活発なんですね。
dialogue.English: Your father-in-law is very active, isn't he?

dialogue.content: はい、そうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 風向きが変わりそうというのはどのような感じのことでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What do you mean by 'the tide may be turning'?

dialogue.content: 小学生の感染で、地域の方も情報が耳に入り
dialogue.English: With an elementary school student getting infected, the news is spreading through the community,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 今までより、シビアになりそうな気がします…
dialogue.English: I feel like people are going to become much more severe about it than before...

dialogue.content: なるほど。みなさん、慎重になりそうですよね
dialogue.English: I see. It sounds like everyone may become more cautious.

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: おじいさまはどのくらいの頻度で外出されるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How often does your father-in-law go out?

dialogue.content: 最低でも、週に5日は外出します
dialogue.English: He goes out at least five days a week.

dialogue.content: 週のほとんどを外出されているのですね
dialogue.English: So he's out most days of the week.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どこに行かれているのかはご存じなんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Do you know where he goes?

dialogue.content: ニュースでも取り上げていますが、飲食店を利用しています
dialogue.English: He goes to restaurants, which have been on the news.

dialogue.content: 飲食店ではマスクも利用できないですし、
dialogue.English: And at restaurants, you can’t really keep your mask on,

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。何かを食べにいかれるのですね。ニュースになるくらいですから、心配ですよね
dialogue.English: I see. So he goes out to eat. It's understandable to be worried, especially if it's being covered in the news.

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 確かに・・・食べるときはマスク外しますからちょっと怖いですね
dialogue.English: That's true... you have to take off your mask to eat, so that is a bit scary.

dialogue.content: そうなんです…
dialogue.English: Exactly...

dialogue.content: お話の途中ですが本日何とお呼びしたらよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I'm sorry to interrupt, but what should I call you today?

dialogue.content: あおちゃん　でお願いします・笑
dialogue.English: Please call me Ao-chan. (laughs)

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。あおちゃんさんは、おじいさまにどうしてほしいとお考えでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. Ao-chan, what would you like your father-in-law to do?

dialogue.content: できれば、電車を利用しての外出、飲食店だけは控えてもらいたいです…
dialogue.English: If possible, I'd like him to refrain from taking the train and visiting restaurants...

dialogue.content: 人がいるところや、マスクを外すところは避けてほしいですよね
dialogue.English: You'd like him to avoid places where there are crowds and places where he has to take his mask off, right?

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 日中はおじいさまはお一人で外出されるのですか？だれかと一緒ですか？
dialogue.English: During the day, does your father-in-law go out alone, or with someone?

dialogue.content: ほとんど一人で外出しますが
dialogue.English: He goes out alone most of the time, but...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 町内のお友達のところにも、植木などの趣味仲間としてでかけます
dialogue.English: he also visits his friends in the neighborhood who share his hobbies, like gardening.

dialogue.content: 日頃からアクティブな老人です
dialogue.English: He's always been a very active elderly man.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。行動範囲も広く、とても活動的なおじいさまですね
dialogue.English: I see. He gets around a lot and is very active.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: おじいさまの奥さまは何かおっしゃているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Does his wife, your mother-in-law, say anything about it?

dialogue.content: おばあちゃんは持病がありますが
dialogue.English: Grandma has a chronic illness,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: おじいちゃんを、息子みたいな感覚で捉えています
dialogue.English: and she treats Grandpa kind of like he's her son.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。おばあさまは自分の子供のような感じなんですね
dialogue.English: I see. So she sees him as if he were her child.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 外出のことについてもおじいさまを止めたりはされないのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Does she not try to stop him from going out?

dialogue.content: 程々にしなさいよ
dialogue.English: She tells him, "Don't overdo it."

dialogue.content: と注意はしてくれます
dialogue.English: So she does caution him.

dialogue.content: おじいさまのこと心配されているのですね。おじいさまはあまり言うことをきかないかんじなんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So she's worried about him. Does it seem like he doesn't really listen?

dialogue.content: 言うことをきかないタイプです
dialogue.English: He's the type who doesn't listen.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。困ってしまいますね・・・
dialogue.English: I see. That must be difficult...

dialogue.content: 子どもの方が、この状況に理解あります
dialogue.English: Even the children understand the situation better than he does.

dialogue.content: あおちゃんさんから、おじいさまに外出のことについてはなにかおっしゃったことはありますか？
dialogue.English: Ao-chan, have you said anything to your father-in-law yourself about his going out?

dialogue.content: 私の言い方が悪かったのか、
dialogue.English: Maybe I said it the wrong way, but...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 高齢者の感染は危険だから、外出は控えてね
dialogue.English: I told him, "Infections are dangerous for the elderly, so please refrain from going out."

dialogue.content: と伝えました…
dialogue.English: That's what I told him...

dialogue.content: 心配されていることをお伝えしたのですね。
dialogue.English: So you conveyed your concern to him.

dialogue.content: おじいさまはどんな反応でした？
dialogue.English: How did he react?

dialogue.content: かたくなに「大丈夫だ」と言ってムシされました
dialogue.English: He stubbornly insisted, "I'll be fine," and ignored me.

dialogue.content: それは悲しいですね・・・心配でお伝えしたのにわかってもらえなかったのですね
dialogue.English: That's disheartening... You told him out of concern, but he didn't seem to understand.

dialogue.content: そうですね…悲しかったです
dialogue.English: Yes... I felt sad.

dialogue.content: 義理のお父さまとのことですが、あおちゃんさんの奥さまは何かおっしゃているのですか？
dialogue.English: Since he's your father-in-law, what does your wife say?

dialogue.content: 妻は
dialogue.English: My wife...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 強く言うと反発するから
dialogue.English: She says that if we're too forceful, he'll just push back,

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: と、私をサポートしてくれますが
dialogue.English: so she's supportive of me, but...

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 我が家から感染者が出て、妻までが周りから差別されたらと思うと
dialogue.English: when I think about what would happen if someone in our family got infected and even my wife faced discrimination from others,

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 今をどう対処すれば良いのかわからないです…
dialogue.English: I just don't know how to handle the situation right now...

dialogue.content: 町内の植木仲間なら、庭でマスクして話してる様子なのでまだいいですが
dialogue.English: It's still somewhat okay with his neighborhood gardening friends, as they seem to talk in the yard while wearing masks, but...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 飲食店はさすがに…と思っています
dialogue.English: but restaurants are just... a bit too much, I think.

dialogue.content: そうですよね・・・予防できない場所でのことを想像するとちょっと心配になりますよね
dialogue.English: I understand... It's worrying when you imagine him in a place where it's impossible to take precautions.

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: あおちゃんさんは、おじいさまとはどのような関係でしょうか？例えば・・・よく話すとか、話さないとか
dialogue.English: Ao-chan, what is your relationship with your father-in-law like? For example, do you talk often, or not much?

dialogue.content: おじいちゃんはよく話す人なので、私はその話しを聞いているという感じです
dialogue.English: Grandpa is a very talkative person, so I'm mostly the one who listens to him.

dialogue.content: なるほど、聞き役というかんじなのですね
dialogue.English: I see—you’re more of a listener.

dialogue.content: 少しお話整理してもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Would it be alright if I take a moment to summarize what we've talked about?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 同居されている義父さまが外出をよくされているということでとてもお悩みでいらっしゃいます。
dialogue.English: You're very troubled by the fact that your father-in-law, who lives with you, goes out so often.

dialogue.content: はい！
dialogue.English: Yes!

dialogue.content: 身近でもコロナの感染者がでていることもあり、とても心配です
dialogue.English: And with COVID cases appearing close by, you're very worried.

dialogue.content: そうなんです…
dialogue.English: That's right...

dialogue.content: ご近所の植木仲間とのお話はマスクされているので安心ですが、電車で出かけたり飲食店に行かれることを控えてほしいととても思っていらっしゃいます
dialogue.English: You feel some relief that he wears a mask when talking with his gardening friends, but you strongly wish he would refrain from taking the train and going to restaurants.

dialogue.content: はい！
dialogue.English: Yes!

dialogue.content: おじいさまに控えてねとお伝えしても、聴いてもらえずお困りということでよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: And you're in a difficult position because when you asked him to hold back, he wouldn't listen. Is that correct?

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 高齢者であるということ、マスクをしない場所への外出なので心配ではありますよね。どうしたらいいのか一緒に考えていきたいと思っています
dialogue.English: Given his age and the fact that he goes to places where masks aren't worn, it's understandable to worry. I'd like for us to think together about what we can do.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: おじいさまは飲食店にいかれるということですが、お食事をすることが多いということでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned your father-in-law goes to restaurants. Is it mostly for meals?

dialogue.content: はい、外食が好きです
dialogue.English: Yes, he likes eating out.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。プロの作るごはんはおいしいですよね
dialogue.English: I see. Food made by a professional is delicious, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 自宅でご飯を召し上がることは、あまりないのですか？
dialogue.English: Does he not eat at home very often?

dialogue.content: 夕飯は一緒に食べますが、主にお酒です
dialogue.English: We have dinner together, but for him, it's mostly drinking.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。お昼ご飯はどうされているのでしょう？
dialogue.English: I see. What does he do for lunch?

dialogue.content: 外出してランチです…
dialogue.English: He goes out for lunch...

dialogue.content: まるで仕事のように外出してます
dialogue.English: He goes out as if it were his job.

dialogue.content: 週５日ほどランチに行っていらっしゃるのですね。とてもおいしいお店があるのですね
dialogue.English: So he goes out for lunch about five days a week. There must be some favorite places he enjoys.

dialogue.content: あおちゃんさん、さきほどおじいさまには飲食店や電車に乗るのを控えてほしいとおっしゃていましたが、一番今困っていることはなんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Ao-chan, earlier you said you’d like him to refrain from going to restaurants and taking the train. What is the most pressing concern for you right now?

dialogue.content: そうですね、
dialogue.English: Let's see...

dialogue.content: やはりコロナ感染したら怖いですから、家族を守りたいですね…
dialogue.English: Ultimately, I’m afraid of one of us getting COVID, so I want to protect my family...

dialogue.content: 確かにそうですよね、今は感染しないように予防したいですよね
dialogue.English: That's completely understandable. Right now, you want to do everything you can to prevent infection.

dialogue.content: せめて、おじいちゃんの交友関係が電話でおさまってもらえたらありがたいです・笑
dialogue.English: At the very least, I'd be grateful if Grandpa's social life could be limited to the phone. (laughs)

dialogue.content: なるほど。いろいろな今はツールもありますからね、交流といっても直接会わないでできる方法があったらいいですよね
dialogue.English: I see. There are many tools available these days, so it would be nice if there were ways for him to socialize without meeting in person.

dialogue.content: お子さんがお二人いらっしゃるとおっしゃていましたが、おじいさまとはどのようなかんじですか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned you have two children. What is their relationship with their grandfather like?

dialogue.content: 小学二年生と三年生の娘とは、一緒に遊んでくれます
dialogue.English: He plays with my daughters, who are in second and third grade.

dialogue.content: お孫さんと仲良しなんですね。とてもいいですね
dialogue.English: So he's close with his granddaughters. That's wonderful.

dialogue.content: 遊び方が女の子なので、多少は合わせてくれます
dialogue.English: Since they're girls, he adapts to the way they play to some extent.

dialogue.content: とてもやさしいおじいさまですね。
dialogue.English: He sounds like a very kind grandfather.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 先ほどのツール、
dialogue.English: About the tools you mentioned earlier,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: おじいちゃんはガラケーで、昔の人なので
dialogue.English: Grandpa uses a flip phone, and he’s old-fashioned, so...

dialogue.content: パソコンは苦手ですが、
dialogue.English: he's not good with computers, but,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 少し、おじいちゃんに相談してみようかと…
dialogue.English: I'm thinking I might try talking to him about it a little...

dialogue.content: そうですね。もしかしたら、興味をもってくれるかもしれませんよね
dialogue.English: That's a good idea. He might just take an interest in it.

dialogue.content: あおちゃんさんは、どのような予防対策されていますか？
dialogue.English: Ao-chan, what kind of preventative measures are you taking yourself?

dialogue.content: 出勤する時はマスクをして
dialogue.English: I wear a mask when I go to work,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 妻に持たされている消毒をしています
dialogue.English: and I use the sanitizer my wife makes me carry.

dialogue.content: いろいろと対策されていてとてもすばらしいです
dialogue.English: It's wonderful that you're taking various measures.

dialogue.content: おじいさまはとても行動力のある方で、元気ということはとてもいいことですよね。
dialogue.English: Your father-in-law is very energetic and proactive—that in itself is a wonderful thing.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: しかし、今のご時世、いつどこで感染するかわからない脅威もあるので、とても心配だと思います
dialogue.English: However, in this day and age, there's the threat of catching it anywhere, anytime, so I imagine you're very worried.

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: あおちゃんさんは高齢であるおじいさまのこと、そして家族のことても心配されいて、守ろうというお気持ちとても家族愛が強い方と思いました
dialogue.English: Ao-chan, I can see that you're very worried about your elderly father-in-law and your family. Your desire to protect them shows me that you're a person with a strong love for your family.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます！
dialogue.English: Thank you!

dialogue.content: 外食などが好きというおじいさまに、例えばテイクアウトできるものとか、週５から週３～２に外食を減らしていただくようにお願いしてみるのはどうなのかな？と、思い、私の考えをお伝えしました。
dialogue.English: For a father-in-law who loves eating out, I was just thinking, what if you asked him to perhaps try some takeout options, or reduce his outings from five days a week to two or three? I just wanted to share that thought with you.

dialogue.content: そうですね、最近、テイクアウトするお店、増えてますから
dialogue.English: That's true. More and more restaurants are offering takeout these days.

dialogue.content: さきほど、パソコンなどのことも相談されてみるとおっしゃっていたので、いろいろとおじいさまにご相談されてみられたらいいですね
dialogue.English: You mentioned earlier that you might talk to him about things like computers, so it might be good to discuss various options with him.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: すいません、かぶってしまいました
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, I spoke over you.

dialogue.content: いえいえ
dialogue.English: No, no, it's fine.

dialogue.content: 新しい生活の開始かもしれないです！
dialogue.English: This might be the start of a new lifestyle!

dialogue.content: 新しいよい風が吹いてきているかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: A new, favorable wind might be starting to blow.

dialogue.content: おじいちゃんがリモートし始めたら、より一層、パワーアップしそうですが、安心します・笑
dialogue.English: If Grandpa starts doing things remotely, he'll probably become even more super-powered, but I'll feel more at ease. (laughs)

dialogue.content: 本日お話されてみていかがでしたか？
dialogue.English: How do you feel after talking today?

dialogue.content: 自分の責任が重くて
dialogue.English: I’ve been feeling a heavy sense of responsibility,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 辛かったですが、ラクになりました
dialogue.English: It was tough, but I feel lighter now.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 少しでもあおちゃんさんのお気持ちが楽になるお手伝いができてうれしくおもいます。
dialogue.English: I'm happy if I was able to help you, Ao-chan, feel even a little more at ease.

dialogue.content: 本日はこれでご相談終了とさせていただきますが、よろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I'd like to conclude our session for today, if that's alright with you.

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes,

dialogue.content: また何かありましたら、ご相談させていただきます！
dialogue.English: If anything else comes up, I'll be sure to reach out again!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Thank you so much!

dialogue.content: 本日はお話聴かせていただきありがとうございました。みなさんが何事もなく過ごせることお祈りしています。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing with me today. I wish you and your family safety and well-being.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much. Goodbye.

dialogue.content: 本日はご相談ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your consultation today.

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました。これでロールプレイ終了させていただきます）
dialogue.English: (Thank you. That concludes this role-play session.)

dialogue.content: （本日はありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for today.)

dialogue.content: （とても勉強になりました。それでは、失礼いたします）
dialogue.English: (This was a great learning experience. Goodbye.)

dialogue.content: （こちらこそ大変、勉強になりました。失礼いたします。）
dialogue.English: (It was a great learning experience for me as well. Goodbye.)
